items: For a multi-location brand, trust comes from guests getting the same quality and service at every location, and any inconsistency puts loyalty and sales at risk.
Guests who trust your brand are more likely to return and to recommend you, which makes word-of-mouth one of your strongest growth drivers.
Respond promptly to both positive and negative feedback, and resolve issues raised in public openly, so guests see you take accountability.
When a recall or safety issue happens, a fast and transparent response protects your reputation and shows you put guest safety first.
Being open about sourcing, nutrition and how you handle operational problems builds confidence with guests, employees and investors.
